query: What is the amount range of the deductible under MediShield Life based on age and ward class?
reference_answer: The deductible under MediShield Life ranges from $2,000 to $4,500, depending on the claimant's age and choice of ward class.
context:
[Document 1]
The deductible under MediShield Life ranges from $2,000 to $4,500, depending on the claimant's age and choice of ward class.

[Document 2]
Older Pioneer Generation seniors with serious pre-existing conditions receive additional MediSave top-ups of $50 to $200 annually from 2021 to 2025, which can be used to pay MediShield Life premiums.

[Document 3]
The claimable amount is $1,000 and it is less than the deductible of $2,000, so there is no payout from MediShield Life.

[Document 4]
It depends on several factors, including the age when one sets aside the Enhanced Retirement Sum (ERS) and when one starts payouts.The ERS in 2025 is $426,000.Illustrations on estimated monthly payouts for members who top up to ERS in 2025:Members who top up on reaching age 55 in 2025 can receive CPF LIFE monthly payouts of $3,100 – $3,300 for life from age 65.Members turning 65 in 2025 who had previously set aside their cohort Full Retirement Sum at age 55 can receive CPF LIFE monthly payouts of $2,500 – $2,700.You can use theMonthly payout estimatorto estimate your payouts if you top up to the raised ERS.

[Document 5]
The MediSave payable is based on your annual net trade income (NTI) derived as a self-employed person and not the number of licences. If you have a total yearly NTI of more than $6,000 from your licence(s), you are required to make contributions to your MediSave Account.
answer: The deductible under MediShield Life ranges from $2,000 to $4,500, depending on age and ward class. However, specific ranges for different age groups or ward classes aren't detailed in the provided documents. [Document 1]
